com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.datamodel

Class LDAIConfigTypes.Model

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.datamodel.LDAIConfigTypes.Model
  • Enclosing class:
    LDAIConfigTypes

    public static final class LDAIConfigTypes.Model
extends java.lang.Object
    Configuration describing the model an AI Config should use.

    Instances are immutable. The parameters and custom maps hold arbitrary values decoded from the JSON protocol; their values are plain Java types (String, Double, Boolean, List, Map, or null). Build instances with builder(String).
